What's different in Timeless Jade

The Pokémon side of the hack at a glance. Each Pokémon's own entry has its current stats, abilities, typing and moves.

Battles

  • Modern battle rules: the Fairy type, the physical/special split by move, and abilities, moves and items up to the newest games.
  • The move menu shows how effective each move is against the opponent (Super, Neutral, Resisted, Immune), taking abilities like Levitate into account.
  • Frostbite replaces freeze. A frostbitten Pokémon still acts every turn, loses 1/16 of its max HP at the end of each turn, and its special moves do half damage, like a special-side burn. Ice types can't get it. It is cured like any status (Aspear or Lum Berry, Ice Heal, Natural Cure…), but Fire moves don't thaw it.
  • New moves: Hoarfrost (Ice, special, 80 power, hits everyone next to the user, 30% frostbite) and Jack Frost (Ice status move that inflicts frostbite, like Will-O-Wisp). Blizzard can now cause frostbite too.
  • New held item: the Frost Orb, which frostbites its holder at the end of the turn, like the Flame Orb.

Moves and TMs

  • Every Pokémon's level-up moves were reworked: a usable move of its own type early, stronger moves around levels 16–20 and 30–38, no long gaps, and moves that fit its stats, abilities and look. Evolved Pokémon keep the moves their earlier stages learn.
  • 246 TMs, each teaching a different move, and none of them is used up. Some are new, like TM225 Moonblast or TM234 Mega Kick.
  • A TM can teach a Pokémon any TM move it learns by level-up, as an Egg move or from a tutor, as well as its own TM list.
  • HM moves can be forgotten. Field moves work straight from the Bag: with the HM in your Bag, any party Pokémon that could learn it can use it. Headbutt works the same way with TM222.

The party menu's Customize option

  • Nature: change a Pokémon's nature.
  • Ability: switch to any ability its species can have, including the hidden one.
  • Moves: Re-Learn any level-up move up to its level, or TMs/HMs to teach any move from the TMs and HMs in your Bag that it can learn.
  • Nickname: rename a Pokémon you caught.

Finding and raising Pokémon

  • Regional Charm: while it's switched on, wild Pokémon that have an Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian or Paldean form always appear in that form. Scripted encounters are never changed.
  • Exp. Share is a key item you can switch on and off. While it's on, the Pokémon that didn't battle get 25% of the EXP.
  • Headbutt trees always have a Pokémon in them, and which tree gives which list no longer depends on your Trainer ID.
  • Every evolution item is sold on the Goldenrod Department Store's 4th floor. Pokémon that evolve by trading can also evolve with a Linking Cord, except Karrablast and Shelmet, which still trade for each other.
  • Gift Eggs hatch quickly. The Day-Care Man on Route 34 gives an Odd Egg holding one of 17 baby Pokémon, shiny 14% of the time.
